use_case_summary: Cerulean runs a global ecommerce catalog search + recommendations platform. They require a semantic embeddings + reranker pipeline at massive scale: initial index ~700M vectors, steady-state ingest 0.5-1M vectors/day, aiming to keep end-to-end retrieval+rerank p50 <50ms and p95 <200ms. Must minimize per-query unit cost (target <$0.0015) via batching, prefix/KV caching, and using quantized indexes with reranker only on top-K. Needs VPC/private deployment for PCI-adjacent workloads and EU data residency for EU customers. POC focuses on backfill throughput, recall@10, latency, and cost-per-1k-queries modeling.
